verdicts.problem: The gene and variant (COL4A1:p.Gly332Arg) are printed in the text, but the carrier count conflicts within the paper (174 in Results and Table 2, 172 in the Location of Variants section). Setting n_families equal to carrier count is unsupported because the paper implies related individuals exist by reporting a separate analysis restricted to unrelated individuals.

challenge.notes: This is a population biobank study (UK Biobank), not ascertained families. Of the 11 COL4A1/2 variants, only p.Gly332Arg is named in the provided text; the others are in eTable 5, which was truncated. The paper gives the p.Gly332Arg carrier count as both 174 and 172.

challenge.notes:
All 11 records match Tables 2 and 3. Each record is one unrelated ICH patient, and the 1/1 proband and family counts are consistent with the text. The quoted case narratives (Patients 1–3) map correctly to the patient IDs.

The missed_variants list covers two groups of variants observed in this cohort that have no record:
- Common SNPs. rs3742207 is nominally associated with 1-year death; rs2275843 deviated from Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium in controls.
- Rare variants present in both cases and controls (Supplementary Table 3). These designations are known only from the model-generated Figure 1 transcription.

Literature-cited variants that were not observed in this cohort were not listed as missed. These are G562E, COL4A1I110T/rs138269346, Ala144Val, Lys950Glu, Ser1582Pro, Met1Thr, c.2085del, c.2194-1G > A, and COL4A2 H203L/rs201716258.

COL4A2 was not sequenced in this study.

challenge.notes:
All records come from a model transcription of Figure 4. Gene assignment is still supported by author text: the caption maps panel A to COL4A1 (NM_001845.6) and panel B to COL4A2 (NM_001846.4), and the transcription shows panels labeled A and B.

The text gives 30 distinct COL4A1 variants, which matches the transcription. It gives 9 distinct COL4A2 variants, but only 8 were transcribed, so one COL4A2 variant was apparently unreadable. Two further COL4A2 patients had no available reports.

The text says four variants were seen in 2 patients each (3 sibling sets plus one pair not described as siblings). The transcription, however, shows five recurrent COL4A1 variants: c.1241G>A, c.2258C>A, c.2317G>A, c.3611G>C and c.2269_2276del. One of those duplications is likely a transcription error, and per-variant family counts for the recurrent records cannot be resolved.

Inheritance is recorded as unknown throughout, but the text describes some inherited cases that cannot be mapped to specific variants:
- A late-childhood COL4A1 sibling pair with sensorineural hearing loss inherited a VUS from their father.
- Two asymptomatic patients were tested because of a symptomatic parent.
